added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the brief asked that every oddly named path be traced to the command that created it wherever a transcript or git history allows, but F7 and F8 record only mtime, size and contents and push the attribution into the remedy column (evidence.md §8-§9 name no invocation), so the quoting defect that keeps minting these paths is diagnosed by shape but not located.

follow-on: the config-home sizes are du --block-size=1M figures labelled MB and converted to GB by dividing by 1000, understating every §1 size by about 4.9% and making §1's 94.5 GB for ~/.cache/reckon appear to contradict §4's 99.1 GB of the ledger files it holds; the two are the same 94,519 MiB quantity, and a reader cannot tell which figure is trustworthy.
follow-on: the F6 estimated-lines cell is the placeholder +0/+X rather than a number, so the row's cost estimate is unreadable where every other row carries one.

item_verdicts.diff: a read-only investigation node has no repository diff; its landed deliverable is the report under the config-home reports tree, which I read in full against evidence.md.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is report.md carrying a method, a per-finding evidence column, a top-five list and the exact tally line; the manifest records tail -n 1 report.md producing findings=10 high=3 mid=3 low=4 owned=1 regressed=0 unowned=9, which I re-read at report.md's last line.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a read-only census of what accumulates in reckon's runtime state and checkout with no cleaner; report.md answers each of the brief's six measurement areas (state-dir sizes, lock/run ages, odd-named paths, worktrees, crew gc coverage, tracked-state churn) over evidence.md's twelve recorded commands, and its closing tally findings=10 high=3 mid=3 low=4 matches the table.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it serves status complete with a checkpoint, names the same five changed_paths under the grant, records the tally command and its result, and states retry_failures: none with the one timeout-and-bounded-pass detail.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's grant is the reports directory reports/reckon/health-review-1010/health-state-hygiene; every artefact it names (report.md, evidence.md, measure_state.py/.out, measure_worktrees.py) sits inside it and it reports no repository edit, matching its manifest's changed_paths.

justifications.durability: a point-in-time census has no regression surface, but the node's own reproducibility rests on measure_state.py and measure_worktrees.py (report.md Method), and neither carries an assertion or expected-value guard that would fail if the census mechanism were changed out from under it.
justifications.evidence: I reproduced the load-bearing figures independently - ledger cache 1646 files/100.4 GB (report 1629/99.1), locks 11951 run-shaped/10852 ledgered (report 11888/10813), 568 orphan run dirs exactly (report 568), commits 6898/3750 promote-release (report 6806/3702), and the cited lines reckon/ledger.py:896-899, reckon/ledger.py:896-899 and reckon/crew/routing.py:1764-1771 read true - but evidence.md §1 mislabels du --block-size=1M output as MB and converts it to GB by /1000, so its 94.5 GB directory figure appears to contradict its own 99.1 GB contents (finding 2).
justifications.fit: report.md and evidence.md follow the report-plus-evidence-and-scripts idiom the shared health-review brief prescribes, and no filename, symbol or comment carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: report.md answers five of the brief's six areas fully, but its brief item 3 obligation to name the producing command for the odd-named paths is left as inference rather than attribution (report.md F7/F8 remedy cells; evidence.md §8-§9).
justifications.reuse: the two added scripts (measure_state.py, measure_worktrees.py) read the existing run store, live-pointer and worktree registries rather than re-deriving them, and the report names the owners it consulted (routing.py garbage_collect, ledger.py _run_index_path, runs.py _pointer_lock).
justifications.scope_discipline: the node is read-only by contract and every artefact it wrote is inside the granted reports directory; it edited no repository file, as its manifest's commits: none and the clean subject worktree confirm.
